svg.title: Planit Stage 2 — MVC and Facade (selected operations)

g.text: Planit Stage 2 — MVC and Facade (selected operations)
Panels receive Dashboard and delegate to its controller.
GUI: mvn javafx:run; CLI: mvn compile exec:exec@cli.
Solid arrow: association; dashed arrow: dependency; filled diamond: composition.
Solid line with hollow triangle: class inheritance (App extends Application).
Facade creates its adaptive service; injected services use plain associations.
Generic operation bodies, constructors and most forwarding methods omitted.
